tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Soft blush by day, warm charcoal at night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and lists on bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom bar, sheets and anything floating above a surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet wells inside a card, such as a quoted line.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and times on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand colour, a dusty rose. Main buttons, the mic button, the leave by card, active tab, links on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Calm tint for chips, icon tiles and selected rows.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-soft.

tokens.name: nudge-soft
tokens.usage: Background of gentle nudges: a goal gone quiet, something to grab, a restart offer.

tokens.name: nudge-ink
tokens.usage: Text and buttons on nudge-soft.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Muted clay for delete and other actions that cannot be undone. Text or icon on bg. Never used for missed tasks.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a delete confirmation.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: Text on caution-soft.

tokens.name: private
tokens.usage: Phone only badges and the private reminder card on tablets.

tokens.name: on-private
tokens.usage: Text and icons on private.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Edge of outline buttons and plain chips. The control edge that line must never be.

tokens.name: night-bg
tokens.usage: Tablet night, dimmed (dark only, so the same in both).

tokens.name: night-clock
tokens.usage: The big clock on the dimmed night screen.

tokens.name: night-text
tokens.usage: Labels and the first-thing cards on the dimmed night screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon or checkbox and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections. Gap between tablet columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tablet screen padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and small wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and lists on the phone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards on the phone, all cards on tablets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges and the mic button.
